reason: The requested visuals are dynamic physical state rendered from live simulation fields. Three.js terrain/tree geometry, procedural water shading, flame/smoke fields, lighting and shadows are the semantically correct assets; no raster generation was requested.

water.meaning: depth and flow in the terrain channel/pond
water.mapping: terrain heightfield plus live water surface; flow velocity drives direction, foam and ripples; zero depth exposes ground
water.2d: Same water surface and simulation seen through an orthographic overhead camera; no separate vector-field lab.
water.3d: heightfield water surface with depth-aware color, directional flow and contact foam
water.must_not_use: static water bitmap or decorative blue overlay

fire.meaning: active combustion rate and thermal field
fire.mapping: flame/smoke field driven by fire, fuel, temperature and wind; burned fuel removes canopy/vegetation; radiation heats neighbors
fire.2d: cell flame intensity, heat glow and smoke direction from same simulation
fire.3d: Procedural billboard flame columns and wind-advected smoke particles anchored to actual burning cells; not a volumetric gas solver.
fire.must_not_use: unlinked particle loop or icon that persists after fuel/water suppression

sunlight.meaning: incident solar irradiance after slope and terrain occlusion
sunlight.mapping: sun angle plus cached horizon shadow controls lighting, sunlight field and heating; tree/terrain shadows remain in the same world
sunlight.2d: Same sun/terrain/canopy shadows and optional measured-temperature colors as 3D.
sunlight.3d: HDR sky/sun direction and real-time/cached terrain shadows
sunlight.must_not_use: uniform brightness unrelated to hour, slope or occlusion
sunlight.thermal_coupling: Environment hands canopy position, radius, height and opacity to solar occlusion; fuel loss removes canopy shade.

coupled_events.rain_or_brush_water: adds water, advects heat, wets fuel and suppresses fire
coupled_events.fire_spread: consumes fuel, emits heat/radiation, is reduced by wetness and standing water
coupled_events.terrain_edit: changes elevation, redirects flow and changes horizon shadows
coupled_events.tablet_2d_3d: both projections sample the identical world arrays and interaction coordinates

asset_requirements.source_traceability: code-native renderer and simulation fields are the source of truth
asset_requirements.generation_authorization: absent; do not invoke image generation

b_rules.retrieval: Authenticated git fetch; current remote verified by delegated audit
b_rules.decision: Technical-only exception. No content-generative raster assets requested or required. Scientific fields, collision geometry, vector rays and UI icons are code-native.

verification.numerical: Conservation, advection, radiation, wet suppression, terrain/canopy solar occlusion, long-run bounds; final results in publication record
verification.geometry: CPU Three.js instancing, trunk dimensions, perimeter triangles, flooding response and disposal
verification.browser: No browser/GPU visual QA or tablet hardware testing performed; no successful browser inventory from earlier phase
verification.delivery: Static GitHub Pages; final build and remote commit/asset hashes verified at release
